1.web: Deliver me, Yahweh, from the evil man. Preserve me from the violent man;
1.asv: Deliver me, O Jehovah, from the evil man; Preserve me from the violent man:

2.web: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.
2.asv: Who devise mischiefs in their heart; Continually do they gather themselves together for war.

3.web: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.
3.asv: They have sharpened their tongue like a serpent; Adders’ poison is under their lips. [Selah

4.web: Yahweh, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.
4.asv: Keep me, O Jehovah, from the hands of the wicked; Preserve me from the violent man: Who have purposed to thrust aside my steps.

5.web: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.
5.asv: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; They have spread a net by the wayside; They have set gins for me. [Selah

6.web: I said to Yahweh, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, Yahweh.
6.asv: I said unto Jehovah, Thou art my God: Give ear unto the voice of my supplications, O Jehovah.

7.web: Yahweh, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.
7.asv: O Jehovah the Lord, the strength of my salvation, Thou hast covered my head in the day of battle.

8.web: Yahweh, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.
8.asv: Grant not, O Jehovah, the desires of the wicked; Further not his evil device, lest they exalt themselves. [Selah

9.web: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.
9.asv: As for the head of those that compass me about, Let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

10.web: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.
10.asv: Let burning coals fall upon them: Let them be cast into the fire, Into deep pits, whence they shall not rise.

11.web: An evil speaker won’t be established in the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.
11.asv: An evil speaker shall not be established in the earth: Evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

12.web: I know that Yahweh will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.
12.asv: I know that Jehovah will maintain the cause of the afflicted, And justice for the needy.

13.web: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.
13.asv: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: The upright shall dwell in thy presence.
